ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no driver account flag required since the driver merely cancelled nothing and no misuse of the "I'm Here" button is recorded.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver never tapped 'I'm Here' [F4] and never arrived [F1][F3]; the driver did not cancel on rider-no-show grounds, so NS-1/NS-2 do not apply and no fee is owed to the driver.
The rider's stated ground (driver not near) is not a ground for free cancellation under NS-4; she still cancelled within 3 minutes, which is what makes the fee refundable.
